title: Oakland HackWeek — vendor liaison & till notes
body:
Purpose
This is my pocket scratchpad for on-site vendor coordination, petty-till handling, and expense capture during Oakland HackWeek (Mar 9–11). Quick, messy — meant for handoffs if I get pulled into other ops.

High-level flow
- Friday (Mar 6): final confirmation call with venue and AV vendor; drop-off name badges and printed schedules to concierge.
- Mon (Mar 9) morning: vendor arrival 07:30, registration opens 08:00, doors 08:30.
- Daily: reconcile till at 17:45, upload receipts + photo of cash float to shared folder, handover notes to next day lead.

Vendors & contacts (quick dial)
- Venue manager: Elena Soto — elena.soto@oaklandloom.com / +1-510-555-2198. Point of contact for rooms, power access, loading dock. Ask for ramp access code on arrival.
- AV lead: BrightSpark AV — contact: Marco Chen / marco@brightsparkav.com / +1-415-555-0047. Confirm: 2x UHF lav mics, 1x handheld, 1x spare lapel, HDMI switcher, stage monitor, 1x spare laptop adapter.
- Catering: LocalBites Events — Priya K. / priya@localbites.co / +1-510-555-8832. Breakfast boxes: vegetarian + omnivore; coffee urns x2 (decaf + reg). Confirm final headcount by 48h.
- Badge printing: QuickPrint Co. — Samir / samir@qpprint.io / +1-510-555-6677. Deliver badges to concierge by 07:00 on Mon.

On-the-ground cash & till policy (notes to self)
- Float: $300 starting cash (for taxi reimbursements, last-minute vendor tips, incidental snacks). Keep in envelope labelled "HackWeek float" and photo the envelope before handing.
- Max single-person petty reimbursement without receipts = $25 (but prefer receipt always). Anything >$75 must be pre-approved by finance.
- Corporate card (event card) for catering and AV final payments. Use personal card only if emergency; submit expense within 48h and mark with tag "card-emergency".
- When reconciling: upload scanned receipts, add a short line item (payer, reason, amount, cost center: GTM-Events-OKL). Include photo of vendor invoice if they hand a paper copy.

Expense capture template (copy into Expenses upload)
- Date | Vendor | Amount | Paid with (corp / personal) | Reason | Cost center | Receipt (Y/N)
- Example: 2026-03-09 | LocalBites Events | 1,320.00 | corp | Breakfast boxes — Day 1 | GTM-Events-OKL | Y

Day-of checklist (short)
- 06:30 — Arrive, check vendor drop-off at loading dock, confirm ramp code.
- 07:00 — Badge box at concierge, verify count.
- 07:30 — AV walkthrough with Marco (mic check on stage, stage monitor, livestream feed).
- 07:50 — Put float envelope in my secure bag; photo envelope and upload to folder: /Shared/Events/HackWeek/Finance/FloatPhotos
- 08:00 — Registration opens: handout printed schedules, swag table, charger station map.
- 09:00 — Speaker ops: check-in for first 3 talks, get laptops/adapter swap ready.
- 12:30 — Quick cash reconcile (lunch sales, merch).
- 17:30 — Final reconcile, handover notes to evening lead or next-day lead.

Merch & swag sales (till handling)
- Merch box: shirts (sizes shrink wrap), stickers, micro-USB cables. Price list taped inside box.
- Square reader on event iPad: account "redwood-hackweek-2026". If Square offline, accept cash + handwritten receipt.
- Cash sales counted in envelope labeled "merch-day1"; write starting float and final cash.

Last-minute troubleshooting snippets
- If livestream drops: request BrightSpark to restart encoder; fallback: record locally on presenter laptop. Make note of segment/timecode for editing.
- If catering short by >10 ppl: open snack stash (cereal bars) and message Priya to deliver extra sides; place emergency grocery receipt under "catering-shortage" line in expenses.

Notes to self (open questions)
- Do we have a spare HDMI dongle in the event kit? (Check with Marcus before packing)
- Confirm whether the venue accepts separate invoices per day or single invoice for whole event (affects PO creation).
- Who is on backup speaker ops for keynote if Tomás is pulled to sponsor meeting? (Ideally Marcus)

Handoff bullet (for next lead)
- I left the float envelope in the small locked drawer of the registration table (key on lanyard A). Ragged receipts are in the "receipts" folder in the courier bag. Check the daybook (paper) for any verbal refunds (signature required).

Quick personal reminders (packing)
- Label charger hub + 2x USB-C cables.
- Pack small roll of gaffer tape (for signage).
- Bring a sharpie pack and sticky dots for badge fixes.

Scratchy log (raw, timestamped) — fill during event
- 2026-03-09 07:05 — Elena handed ramp code; dock #3 blocked by moving truck, used #2.
- 2026-03-09 08:12 — One lav mic battery died; Marco swapped with spare.
- 2026-03-09 12:44 — Catering short 6 breakfast boxes; used cereal stash. Submitted request to Priya for refund/credit.

Endnotes
- If anything becomes an invoice >$2k, route to finance lead (finance@redwood.ai) with subject: "HackWeek invoice approval — vendor name". Keep receipts and attach photos.
- This doc is my living scratchpad — if you pick it up, add a quick line at top with your name and time so we know who was last.
